title: Available capacity
summary: The machine worker allowance counts registered sessions and unregistered in-flight launches marked level_placement.work_required=true by an item, level or explicit work request; MAIN launches spend no worker lane, including operator launches with a requester session. Registration counts once; ended or terminated workers release capacity. The memory-derived minimum is one worker and explicit limits win. Rejected placement retains real occupancy and cap; unweighed model-pool population is unknown, not zero. Source behavior awaits released first-work receiving proof.
